QuestInfo.name: White Fang Stone
QuestInfo.0: #p3000018# is whining for more Essence Stones. He surely eats a lot...
QuestInfo.1: The place to get the next Essence Stone is #m211040200# in the El Nath region. Defeat #o5140000# and obtain #t4033440#. Make sure to fully prepare yourself since  #o5140000# appears in cold regions.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000018# munched on the Essence Stone with a grin on his face. He's kinda like a big, ugly pet.

0.1: Oh, we must have reached the next stage in our pact! You're reading my mind. I feel so close to you. Let's cuddle...\r\n#L0##bStop it right there, buster. Just give me the name of the next monster.#l\n#k

yes.0: I sense the next delicious morsel in the cold wilds of the El Nath region. I'd say dress warmly, but we can't have anything messing with your Angelic Buster powers, so you'll just have to get a little chilly.

no.0: So... you're gonna get it for me, right?

1.0: Oh, it's all icy-hot on my tongue! This is so neat! \r\n#L0##b(Aww, it's like raising a big, sort of inappropriate tortoise.)#l\n#k

yes.0: Whew, this is good training for you!
